description: This PHP script handles the saving and sending of email records in the vTiger CRM system, including file uploads, email composition, and interactions with mail servers. It also includes conditional logic for server configuration checks and mail handling via specific modules.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: Represents the email record being saved or sent in the CRM system.

methods.name: setObjectValuesFromRequest
methods.description: Populates the email object properties from the HTTP request data.

methods.name: send_mail
methods.description: Handles sending the email via SMTP or internal mail functions.
